app.name: Noetune
app.tagline: Lighten your relationship with life, little by little.

hero.title:
Noetune is a place
to notice your reactions
and gradually rediscover
your natural self.
hero.body:
Follow the questions to write, feel, and breathe,
then notice what changes before and after.
hero.note: Use the complete experience for free.

sections.title:
Little by little, more space opens
in your relationship with the many themes of life.
bodyGroups:
Observe the unseen reactions in your mind
from one small step back.

Noetune is not an app
that gives you answers to your problems
or analyzes you.

You write, feel, and breathe for yourself.

And then,
you notice for yourself
the changes taking place within you.

sections.title: What can change in a single session
items: A vague feeling that had no words begins to take shape
You notice the reaction beneath it
You become able to choose how to relate to it
A little distance opens between you and the emotion
You begin to see the theme from another perspective
You notice the inner change through Before / After

sections.title: What can change by repeating sessions
bodyGroups:
Even with themes that trigger a strong reaction,
meeting them several times
can gradually reveal a change in your relationship with them.
items: Your reaction to the same event begins to change
You begin to notice why you reacted so strongly
You gradually understand for yourself what was behind the reaction
The heaviness or atmosphere you feel when the theme comes to mind begins to change
You notice that you have moved beyond the feeling that “nothing has changed”

bodyGroups:
Every session is free,
as many times as you need.

finalCta.title: Begin with whatever feels slightly present now.

pricing.title:
Today, a little lighter.
Change, built over time.
pricing.lead:
Free includes the complete Noetune session.

Pro is for continuing a theme across time.
pricing.body:
Neither plan uses AI analysis.
Session count is unlimited in Free and Pro.
The difference is whether you want to keep a Journey going over time.

pro.name: Pro
pro.priceNote:
Sign-in required.
When it is ready, you can start from this page.

meaning.title: Pro is not just about keeping records.
meaning.body:
A single session can complete today’s Journey.

But your relationship with a theme
may continue beyond one day.

Pro is for continuing a theme over time.

footer.body:
Start with Free.
No sign-up needed.

legal.cancelAnytime: You can manage your plan anytime.

pauseJourney.title: Bookmark this theme.
pauseJourney.body:
With Pro, you can save what has changed so far
and return to this theme later.
